headline: Brent Futures Flip to Backwardation as Middle East Supply Risks Return
summary: Brent crude futures have returned to backwardation as renewed Middle East conflict and disruptions to oil flows raise expectations of tighter near-term supply. Near-dated prices are rising relative to later contracts.
why: Brent is the main global crude benchmark, traded on ICE in London. Backwardation signals tight prompt supply, which influences fuel costs and energy equities.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Renewed Middle East supply risks are tightening near-term crude supply, pushing the futures curve into backwardation.
